dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A semantics record determined by a predicate S on real numbers, with proofs that S(0) holds and that S is closed under addition and absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The theorem is universal over this choice of S; S classifies the existential remainders in the two error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of valid matrix-multiplication runs with dimensions m by n by q and word length p, containing the model, inputs, scales, word decompositions, overflow proofs, and computed output specified by D030.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All conclusions are universal over inhabitants of this run type.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the run's real m by n input matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A occurs in the exact product AB and in the norm factors of every bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the run's real n by q input matrix B.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: B occurs in the exact product AB and in the norm factors of every bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the run's floating-point model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the unit roundoffs, underflow quantities, format limits, and safe threshold used in the coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of additional error-analysis witnesses for a semantics and run, with the data and conditions specified by D034.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each of the two error bounds is asserted only after universally binding an inhabitant of this type.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real lhs and rhs, the proposition that there exists a real remainder r such that S(r) and lhs is at most rhs plus |r|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the precise form of both error-bound conclusions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient 2 p (p+1) n^2 theta^(-2) Gmin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the accumulation-underflow contribution to both bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real quantity (p+1)u^p.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the leading coefficient and is the left side of the first exact identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient 4 n u^(p-1) theta^(-1) gmin, where p-1 is natural-number subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the input-underflow contribution and appears in the second exact identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: The sum D012 + D010 + D008.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the single combined coefficient in the first error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient (p+1)u^p + (n+p^2)U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the non-underflow contribution in both bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: For coefficient c and matrices A and B, the quantity c ||A||_infinity ||B||_infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales every scalar error coefficient by the two matrix infinity norms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The quantity 2u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the final factor on the right side of the first exact identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coefficient 4 n^2 theta^(-1) gmin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the bracketed coefficient on the right side of the second exact identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The accumulation format's underflow-error bound Gmin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the accumulation-underflow coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The accumulation unit roundoff U = 2^(-accumulation precision).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the coefficient (n+p^2)U.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The input format's underflow-error bound gmin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the input-underflow coefficient and the second identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The input unit roundoff u = 2^(-input precision).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls the word expansion and every power of u in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The matrix infinity norm ||computed-AB||_infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the left-hand side of both error bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The threshold theta = min(fmax_input, sqrt(Fmax_accumulation/n)), with each maximum finite value defined by D037.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls scaling and appears inversely in the underflow coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a semantics from S, S(0), closure of S under addition, and closure of S under absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states all axioms available about the predicate used to classify remainders.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the predicate S from a semantics record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the predicate applied to all remainders.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: A real m by n matrix, represented as a function Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions and scalar type of all matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a format's Boolean subnormal-number flag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the underflow formula and representability rules.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a format's maximum exponent.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the maximum finite magnitude.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a format's minimum exponent.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the underflow quantity and representability range.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of a format's natural-number precision.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines unit roundoff and significand ranges.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the run's computed m by q matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the computed result in the forward error and algorithm specification.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for a run. It requires m,n,q,p>0; a model and matrices A,B; row and column power-of-two scales satisfying D050; scaled entries bounded by theta; p recursively rounded input words for each matrix with no input overflow; no accumulation overflow for all retained word-level dot products and their weighted sum; and computed equal to the unscaled, sequentially rounded retained expansion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the quantified runs to the specified scaled word-decomposition matrix-multiplication algorithm and supplies positivity and no-overflow facts.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: A mixed-precision floating-point model containing input and accumulation formats, rounding functions, no-overflow predicates, error decompositions, representability, and nearest-rounding properties, as constructed by D048.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all arithmetic-format parameters used by a run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the accumulation format from a model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines U, Gmin, Fmax, accumulation rounding, and accumulation overflow.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the input format from a model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines u, gmin, fmax, input rounding, and input overflow.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for an analysis witness. It supplies perturbations Delta A and Delta B with A=Ahat+Delta A and B=Bhat+Delta B and relative norm bounds delta; the exact relation T=Ahat Bhat-O; an S-remainder bounding O by (p-1)u^p||A||||B||; an S-remainder and count r<=np(p+1)/2 bounding ||computed-T|| by ((n+p^2)U+4rn theta^(-2)Gmin)||A||||B||; and S(delta^2||A||||B||), where delta=max(u^p,2nu^(p-1)theta^(-1)gmin).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Inhabitation provides the detailed hypotheses under which the two main bounds are asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: The matrix infinity norm: the maximum over rows of the sum of absolute values in that row.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all matrix norms in the error, coefficients, and analysis assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural numeral 1+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports numeral elaboration only and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: For precision t and maximum exponent emax, the maximum finite magnitude 2^emax(2-2u), where u=2^(-t).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the input and accumulation maximum magnitudes used in theta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: The quantity (n+p^2)U.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the accumulation-rounding contribution to D012 and D064.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: For maximum magnitudes fmax and Fmax, the threshold min(fmax,sqrt(Fmax/n)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines theta.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural numeral 3+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports numeral elaboration only and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The format underflow-error bound: 2^emin/2 without subnormals, and 2^(-precision)2^emin with subnormals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines gmin and Gmin and bounds the additive rounding errors in the model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unit roundoff 2^(-precision).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines u and U and bounds relative rounding errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating-point format with positive precision, integer minimum and maximum exponents satisfying emin<=emax, and a subnormal-number flag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It parameterizes representability, unit roundoff, underflow, and maximum finite values.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the accumulation no-overflow predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts dot products and sequential accumulation in valid runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the accumulation rounding function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines rounded products, rounded sums, and the computed expansion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the input no-overflow predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is required for every recursively extracted input word.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the input rounding function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines each input word in the decompositions of scaled A and B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for a model. The input precision does not exceed the accumulation precision, the accumulation exponent range contains the input range, and each rounding function conditionally has the form x(1+delta)+eta with |delta| bounded by unit roundoff, |eta| bounded by the format underflow quantity, eta*delta=0, a representable result, and minimum distance to x among representable values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the exact floating-point assumptions available through every model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: The infinity norm of a finite real vector, max_i |x_i|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures rows of A and columns of B when selecting scales.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: A scale lambda is an integer power of two and positive; if the vector norm is zero then lambda=1, while if it is positive then theta/(2||x||)<lambda<=theta/||x||.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains every row and column scaling factor in a run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real power 2^emin for an integer exponent emin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the base magnitude in the underflow formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordered list of pairs (i,j) with i,j in Fin p and i+j<p, generated by increasing finite-index enumeration with i outermost.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes both the retained word pairs and their sequential accumulation order.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: The predicate that every pre-round addition acc+term in a sequential rounded fold is allowed, with the next accumulator equal to round(acc+term).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses no-overflow of all intermediate additions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: Column scaling of B: the (i,j) entry is B_ij times mu_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the scaled B whose entries are bounded and decomposed into words.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: Row scaling of A: the (i,j) entry is lambda_i times A_ij.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the scaled A whose entries are bounded and decomposed into words.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The reconstructed matrix Ahat with entries lambda_i^(-1) sum_{k<p} u^k Aword_k(i,j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the perturbation assumptions and exact retained-versus-omitted decomposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: A rounded dot product: each x_k y_k is first accumulation-rounded, then those rounded products are sequentially added with accumulation rounding from initial value zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies each word-pair dot product used by the computed expansion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: The accumulation error matrix computed-T, where T is the exact retained expansion D060.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is bounded in the analysis witness.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: The reconstructed matrix Bhat with entries (sum_{k<p} u^k Bword_k(i,j))mu_j^(-1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the perturbation assumptions and exact retained-versus-omitted decomposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact unscaled retained expansion sum_{i+j<p} u^(i+j) Aword_i Bword_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the reference T for accumulation error and for the omitted-tail identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a dot product, every exact product is accumulation-no-overflow and every pre-round addition in the sequential rounded sum is accumulation-no-overflow.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the per-dot-product no-overflow condition in valid runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real quantity ((p:Real)-1)u^p.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the coefficient in the omitted-tail bound of the analysis witness.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exact unscaled omitted expansion sum_{i+j>=p} u^(i+j) Aword_i Bword_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is bounded by an S-remainder hypothesis and it appears in T=Ahat Bhat-O.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: For underflow count r, the coefficient (n+p^2)U+4rn theta^(-2)Gmin.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds the accumulation error before replacing r by its upper bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each output entry, the sequentially accumulation-rounded sum from zero of u^(i+j) times the rounded dot product of Aword_i and Bword_j, over the ordered retained pair list.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After unscaling, it is required to equal the run's computed matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: The perturbation parameter delta=max(u^p,2n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)gmin).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It bounds the relative matrix perturbations and its squared norm product must satisfy S.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: Boolean case selection between a false branch and a true branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the underflow formula according to the subnormal flag.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: Two-sided diagonal unscaling: C_ij is replaced by lambda_i^(-1) C_ij mu_j^(-1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts the scaled expansion into the computed matrix and defines retained and omitted expansions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor of a format from precision>0, integer emin and emax with emin<=emax, and a Boolean subnormal flag.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the structural restrictions on both model formats.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the p matrices Aword_i from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the input words used to reconstruct A and form the expansion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the p matrices Bword_j from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the input words used to reconstruct B and form the expansion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the column scale mu_j from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales B and unscales the output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the row scale lambda_i from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It scales A and unscales the output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef074
dependency_coverage.meaning: The property that lambda=2^z for some integer exponent z.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts row and column scales to powers of two.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef075
dependency_coverage.meaning: Sequential rounded accumulation of a list: start at a supplied accumulator and replace acc by round(acc+term) for each term; an empty list returns acc.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines rounded dot products and the final retained expansion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef076
dependency_coverage.meaning: A list case eliminator distinguishing the empty list from a head and tail.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements D053 and D075 without changing their mathematical meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef077
dependency_coverage.meaning: Format representability: x is zero or x=s a 2^(e-(t-1)), where s is +/-1, a is natural, and either 2^(t-1)<=a<2^t with emin<=e<=emax, or subnormals are enabled, e=emin, and 0<a<2^(t-1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The model requires rounded outputs to be representable and nearest among representable values.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the two bounds and the pair of exact identities, and combines many packaged assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation induced by a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it gives ordinary real division in the coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the two exact scalar identities and equations inside the run and analysis packages.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous addition operation selected by a type-class instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its target occurrences are ordinary real or natural addition as determined by the supplied instances.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous division operation selected by a type-class instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its target occurrences are ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by a type-class instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its target occurrences are ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The exponentiation operation selected by a type-class instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural powers of real quantities and integer powers of two.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous subtraction operation selected by a type-class instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real subtraction and truncated natural subtraction p-1.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the usual natural powers u^k and theta powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The four dimensions and word length are natural numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Canonical casting of a natural number into a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets m,n,p and counts as real numbers in scalar formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that n+1 is at least two when n is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of real numerals such as 2 and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that n+1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports numeral-instance construction only.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural numeral in a type with the corresponding numeral instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the constants 0,1,2, and 4 in the formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The numeral-one instance induced by a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes 1 the ordinary real number one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, norms, coefficients, scales, and remainders are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes addition in all real-valued formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative monoid with inverse, division, and integer powers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary real division, inverse, and integer powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary natural powers of real quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes multiplication in all scalar formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical embedding of natural numbers into real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets dimensions and counts as real scalars.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative identity 1 in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real constant one.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-addition instance induced by ordinary addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It reduces HAdd on reals or naturals to their standard addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-division instance induced by ordinary division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It reduces HDiv on reals to standard division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-multiplication instance induced by ordinary multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It reduces HMul on reals to standard multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-power instance induced by a power operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes natural and integer exponentiation in the formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous heterogeneous-subtraction instance induced by ordinary subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It reduces HSub to real subtraction or natural truncated subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: An interpretation of a numeral at least two via natural-number casting.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary real constants such as 2 and 4.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number numeral instance mapping each numeral to itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural constants used in indices and exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: instSubNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number subtraction, truncated at zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every natural expression p-1 is max(p-1,0), although valid runs force p>0.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It introduces the independent remainder witnesses in both bounds and witnesses in representability and scaling definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite index type {0,...,n-1}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes matrix rows, columns, words, and finite sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration structure on Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables sums, maxima, and matrix multiplication over finite indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Inv.inv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Multiplicative inversion selected by an inverse instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it supplies 1/theta and inverse row and column scales.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation selected by an order instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses all norm bounds and coefficient inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix over index types m and n is a function m -> n -> entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the functional representation of all matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary finite matrix multiplication, with (MN)_ik=sum_j M_ij N_jk.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines AB, Ahat Bhat, and all exact word-matrix products.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction of matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines computed-AB and other matrix error differences.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies finite real sums and matrix multiplication sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive group structure on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports subtraction, negation, and absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instInv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplicative inversion on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets inverse threshold and inverse scale factors.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary less-than-or-equal order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the intended order in every real inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction a-b=a+(-b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all real differences.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice structure on the real order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports real absolute values, minima, and maxima.

binders: m, n, q, and p are arbitrary natural numbers.
S is an arbitrary predicate on real numbers packaged with S(0), closure under addition, and closure under absolute value.

A run has real matrices A in R^(m by n), B in R^(n by q), and computed in R^(m by q), together with the model, scales, word expansions, positivity, no-overflow conditions, and algorithm equation described below.
For each of the first two conclusions, an additional analysis witness for S and the run is universally bound.
hypotheses: An inhabited run necessarily has m>0, n>0, q>0, and p>0.

The model has input and accumulation formats with positive precisions, input precision no larger than accumulation precision, and an accumulation exponent range containing the input exponent range. Each conditional rounding operation satisfies round(x)=x(1+delta(x))+eta(x), with |delta(x)| bounded by the format unit roundoff, |eta(x)| bounded by the format underflow quantity, eta(x)delta(x)=0, a representable rounded result, and nearest-representable behavior.
Each row of A and column of B is scaled by a positive integer power of two selected within the D050 interval. The resulting scaled entries have absolute value at most theta.

The scaled matrices are recursively decomposed into p input-rounded words. Every word-extraction argument is input-no-overflow. Every retained word-level product and intermediate rounded sum is accumulation-no-overflow, and the final weighted accumulation is accumulation-no-overflow.
The computed matrix is the row- and column-unscaled sequential accumulation of u^(i+j) times rounded dot products of word matrices, over pairs 0<=i,j

The analysis witness supplies reconstructed matrices Ahat and Bhat and perturbations Delta A and Delta B such that A=Ahat+Delta A, B=Bhat+Delta B, ||Delta A||_infinity<=delta||A||_infinity, and ||Delta B||_infinity<=delta||B||_infinity, where delta=max(u^p,2n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)gmin).

Writing T for the exact retained expansion and O for the omitted expansion, the witness gives T=Ahat Bhat-O and an r_o with S(r_o) and ||O||_infinity<=((p:Real)-1)u^p||A||_infinity||B||_infinity+|r_o|.
The witness supplies r_a with S(r_a), a natural underflow count k<=np(p+1)/2, and ||computed-T||_infinity<=((n+p^2)U+4kn theta^(-2)Gmin)||A||_infinity||B||_infinity+|r_a|.
conclusions: There exists a real remainder r with S(r) such that ||computed-AB||_infinity <= [(p+1)u^p + (n+p^2)U + 4n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)gmin + 2p(p+1)n^2 theta^(-2)Gmin] ||A||_infinity ||B||_infinity + |r|.

Independently, there exists a real remainder r with S(r) such that ||computed-AB||_infinity <= [(p+1)u^p+(n+p^2)U]||A||_infinity||B||_infinity + [4n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)gmin]||A||_infinity||B||_infinity + [2p(p+1)n^2 theta^(-2)Gmin]||A||_infinity||B||_infinity + |r|.
For every run, (p+1)u^p = ((p+1)/2)u^(p-1)(2u), where the division by 2 is real division and p-1 in the exponent is natural subtraction.
For every run, n[4n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)gmin] = u^(p-1)[4n^2 theta^(-1)gmin].
mathematical_definitions: For a real matrix X, ||X||_infinity=max_i sum_j |X_ij|.
u=2^(-t_in) and U=2^(-t_acc), where t_in and t_acc are the input and accumulation precisions.

For a format with precision t, minimum exponent emin, and subnormal flag s, underflow(t,emin,s)=2^emin/2 if s is false, and 2^(-t)2^emin if s is true. Let gmin be this quantity for the input format and Gmin for the accumulation format.
For a format with precision t and maximum exponent emax, maxFinite(t,emax)=2^emax(2-2^(1-t)). Let fmax be the input value and Fmax the accumulation value.
The combined scalar coefficient is C=(p+1)u^p+(n+p^2)U+4n u^(p-1)theta^(-1)gmin+2p(p+1)n^2 theta^(-2)Gmin.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every choice of natural dimensions, every remainder semantics closed under zero, addition, and absolute value, every valid scaled p-word mixed-precision matrix-multiplication run, and every supplied analysis witness for that run, the forward matrix infinity-norm error is bounded by the stated combined rounding and underflow coefficient times ||A||_infinity||B||_infinity, up to the absolute value of an existential S-classified remainder. The theorem states this bound twice, once with one combined coefficient and once with its three norm-scaled contributions written separately. Independently of the analysis witness, every valid run also satisfies the two displayed exact scalar identities.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although m,n,q,p are quantified over all natural numbers, the run constructor requires all four to be positive. If any is zero, the run type has no constructor inhabitant and every universal statement over runs is vacuous.

The two error bounds quantify over an analysis witness. For a run with no inhabitant of the analysis-witness type, those bound clauses are vacuous. The two exact identities still quantify only over runs.
The bound clauses do not assert existence of either a run or an analysis witness.

The predicate S is arbitrary apart from containing zero and being closed under addition and absolute value. No numerical smallness, asymptotic order, variable dependence, or uniqueness of S-classified remainders is encoded.
The two bounds contain separate existential remainders; the proposition does not require the witnesses to coincide.
Each bound is one-sided and has the form E<=explicit term+|r|.

Occurrences of p-1 used as an exponent employ truncated natural subtraction. This agrees with the ordinary predecessor on every inhabited run because p>0. The omitted-tail coefficient D062 instead uses real subtraction (p:Real)-1.
The first exact identity would not generally hold at p=0, but it is asserted only for runs, and no run can have p=0.
The computed result is not arbitrary: run inhabitation ties it to the particular ordered, sequentially rounded retained word expansion.

All no-overflow, representability, scaling, format-containment, and nearest-rounding conditions are encoded through the run and model constructors rather than stated as separate antecedents in the displayed target.
No claim is made for computations violating any packaged no-overflow condition.
The proposition does not explicitly identify S with a conventional second-order asymptotic class; the label secondOrder is only a field name.
